ValidationRule.description: ECIC LATAM CRC Bottler Agent Profile user can only create cases for the new 11 countries & the country code should match with the user
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( $Profile.Name = "ECIC LATAM CRC Bottler Agent Profile", $Profile.Name = "Nexus Data Loader" ), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", TEXT($User.UserType) <> "AutomatedProcess", OR( ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c, "BS"), ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c, "BB"), ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c, "BZ"), ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c, "CW"), ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c, "GD"), ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c, "GY"), ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c, "HT"), ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c, "MQ"), ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c, "LC"), ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c, "SR"), ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c, "AW") ), TEXT(Country_Code__c) <> TEXT($User.Country_Code__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: ECIC LATAM CRC Bottler Agent Profile user can only create cases for their own country
